items.name: FOA Checklist Maker Extraction
items.description: Uploads a Federal Funding Opportunity Announcement (FOA) and returns a single structured JSON object covering the eight reference sections a federal-grants office uses for FOA review: FOA summary and key dates, funding and eligibility, evaluation criteria with weights, multi-stage review process, agency priorities and program goals, submission platform and forms, application components, and formatting requirements. Output conforms to the foa-checklist-extraction-udm component schema. The runtime mirrors the ui-insight/ProcessMapping foa-checklist-extraction workflow (six parallel Extraction tasks plus a Consolidation Prompt).

data.name: extract-foa-identification-and-timeline
data.prompt:
Extract FOA identifying information, funding details, critical
dates timeline, period of performance, and eligibility overview.

Be 100% accurate. Match the schema's type for each field
exactly:
  - total_funding is a JSON number (no quotes, no currency
    symbol, no thousand-separators).
  - expected_awards is a JSON integer.
  - cost_sharing_required is a JSON boolean (or null).
  - award_range, performance_period, and the date strings
    inside critical_dates are STRINGS, quoted verbatim
    preserving "$300,000 to $750,000 per award" / date format /
    etc.

For federal_agency return one of: NSF, NIH, DOD, DOE, NASA,
USDA, EPA, DOT, DOC, ED, Other.

items.searchphrase: Funding Opportunity Number / ID (e.g., PA-24-246, DE-FOA-0003117).
items.title: foa_number

items.searchphrase: CFDA Number and title.
items.title: cfda_number

items.searchphrase: Federal Agency Name (NSF, NIH, DOD, DOE, NASA, USDA, EPA, DOT, DOC, ED, Other).
items.title: federal_agency

items.searchphrase: FOA Title / Program Name.
items.title: foa_title

items.searchphrase: Total available funding as a JSON number (no quotes, no currency symbol, no thousand-separators). "$10,000,000" becomes 10000000.
items.title: total_funding

items.searchphrase: Expected number of awards as a JSON integer.
items.title: expected_awards

items.searchphrase: Minimum and maximum award amounts (e.g., "$300,000 to $750,000 per award").
items.title: award_range

items.searchphrase: Boolean. Whether cost sharing/matching is required.
items.title: cost_sharing_required

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {milestone, date_time, notes} for all gating milestones (LOI, pre-application, full application, panel review, anticipated start).
items.title: critical_dates

items.searchphrase: Expected project duration range.
items.title: performance_period

items.searchphrase: Flat list of eligible applicant types as stated.
items.title: eligible_applicants

data.name: extract-evaluation-criteria
data.prompt:
Extract all evaluation criteria with weights, scoring system
overview, methodology, and minimum thresholds. Quote weights
verbatim — points or percentages as the FOA states them.

items.searchphrase: Total possible points or scoring scale (e.g., "100 points").
items.title: total_points

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {criterion_name, weight, description, rating_definitions} for each evaluation criterion.
items.title: evaluation_criteria

items.searchphrase: How scores are calculated, tie resolution, weighting.
items.title: scoring_methodology

items.searchphrase: Minimum score thresholds for funding consideration.
items.title: minimum_threshold

data.name: extract-review-process
data.prompt:
Extract review stages, review personnel types, initial screening
criteria, and review timeline. review_stages is sequential —
each stage's outcome is what proceeds to the next.

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {stage_name, purpose, outcome} in sequential order.
items.title: review_stages

items.searchphrase: Types and composition of review panels.
items.title: review_personnel

items.searchphrase: Flat list of initial-screening / disqualification factors.
items.title: screening_criteria

items.searchphrase: Estimated length of review process and notification timeline.
items.title: review_timeline

data.name: extract-agency-priorities-and-goals
data.prompt:
Extract agency mission alignment, program goals and objectives,
priority areas (in stated order of importance), and expected
outcomes.

items.searchphrase: Agency mission relevant to this FOA.
items.title: agency_mission

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {goal, objective, success_indicator} for each program goal.
items.title: program_goals

items.searchphrase: Flat list of priority areas in stated order of importance.
items.title: priority_areas

items.searchphrase: Flat list of required deliverables / intended impacts.
items.title: expected_outcomes

data.name: extract-forms-and-submission-systems
data.prompt:
Extract submission platform details, required registrations
(SAM, UEI, eRA Commons, Grants.gov, agency portals), required
forms, and the application-components checklist with page
limits.

items.searchphrase: Primary submission system (Grants.gov, eRA Commons, etc.).
items.title: submission_platform

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {system_name, timeline, prerequisites} for SAM, UEI, eRA Commons, Grants.gov, agency portals.
items.title: required_registrations

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {form_number, name, purpose, special_instructions} for required forms.
items.title: required_forms

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {component_name, required_or_optional, page_limit, format_requirements} for each component.
items.title: application_components

data.name: extract-formatting-requirements
data.prompt:
Extract document structure, page limits with what-counts rules,
formatting standards, and file requirements.

items.searchphrase: Flat list of required proposal sections in exact order.
items.title: document_structure

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {section, limit, what_counts, consequences} for each page-limit rule.
items.title: page_limits

items.searchphrase: Margin, font, spacing, and other formatting requirements.
items.title: formatting_standards

items.searchphrase: Acceptable file formats, sizes, naming conventions.
items.title: file_requirements

data.name: foa-checklist-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are assembling the FOA Checklist extraction output. The
input is the JSON fragment produced by the upstream six
parallel Extraction tasks. Your job is to emit a single JSON
object that validates against the
foa-checklist-extraction-udm@0.1.0 schema (31 fields).

Rules:
1. Pass-through every field from the six fragments verbatim.
   The schema has no nested re-shaping for this workflow — the
   fragments map directly to top-level fields.
2. Verify cross-field consistency: critical_dates entries
   chronological (LOI/pre-app < full-app < panel review);
   expected_awards * max(award_range) <= total_funding.
   Preserve document values when they conflict; surface the
   conflict via validation_plan.
3. federal_agency must use the enum value exactly. Normalize
   document phrasings to the closest enum.
4. Use null for missing scalar fields and empty arrays for
   missing list fields; never invent values.
5. Do not output any text outside the single JSON object.

validation_plan.check_description: Verify foa_number matches a known agency format pattern (e.g., NIH PA/PAR/RFA, DOE DE-FOA, NSF program-solicitation).
Verify critical_dates entries are chronologically ordered and that LOI/pre-application precedes full-application precedes panel review.
